sketches.mechanism: Borrow checker prevents simultaneous mutable references — you cannot have two mutable borrows of the same value at the same time
sketches.resonance: You cannot change someone while someone else is already changing them; a person can only be transformed by one force at a time.

sketches.mechanism: Weak references automatically become nil when the referenced object is deallocated, requiring optional unwrapping to access
sketches.resonance: Some connections weaken without anyone choosing it — you reach for them and find nothing there.

sketches.mechanism: Unification failure — a query with contradictory bindings simply fails without error, returning false
sketches.resonance: Asking the world to make two incompatible things equal doesn't cause destruction — it just quietly returns: no.
